spans.notes: Pax stands among a crowd of dark penguin silhouettes passing by, looking left and right; hidden behind blurred foreground silhouettes until ~f22. Slow continuous push-in: a scale fit on Pax's feet gives 1.006 (f28-33), 1.019 (f28-43), 1.050 (f28-78), 1.062 (f28-98), overlap 0.97-0.995 vs 0.15 unscaled. The plain backdrop has no fixed edges, so keep12 cannot show it

closer view of Pax with his flippers clasped, then a blushing smile with his flippers out, while blurred silhouettes pass in the foreground. Very slow push-in: feet scale fit f103 to f140/f170/f185 = 1.006/1.010/1.026 (overlap ~1.0). Judgement call: only ~2.6% over the shot, but it is not locked
wipe: the picture slides left past Pax into the moving crowd (storyboard WIPE TRANSITION)
big blurred dark silhouettes fill the screen; Polly is hidden behind them until ~f205

beats.text: {x1} shuffles past in front, uncovering Polly standing in the middle of the crowd
Polly stands among the crowd and spreads her flippers out to the sides, looking straight ahead with wide eyes
Polly squeezes her eyes shut in a wide happy grin
Polly hops up off the ground with both flippers spread wide

spans.notes: Polly's feet stay at the same pixels from f211 to f238 (static camera); the crowd row and the blurred foreground silhouettes are side characters, not lookalikes. Polly is partly behind a passing silhouette until ~f214

spans.view: with a warm spotlight beam shining down onto a lit circle on the floor

beats.text: Polly lands from a little hop in the spotlight with both flippers raised and her eyes shut in a grin
Polly waves one raised flipper with a blushing smile while little sparkles twinkle around her

spans.notes: compare f243/f287: spotlight cone and floor circle edges overlap exactly, camera locked. The spotlight is a local drawn light cone, not a whole-picture effect
